376:  laamp_base_contract_schemes.6021.desc.employer_child: ""[employer_child.GetFirstName], that's enough." [employer.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] looks directly at me."
377:  laamp_base_contract_schemes.6021.desc.random_child: "The alerted peasants quickly join [dummy_gender.GetHerHim]: "Is this the best that our [employer.GetLadyLord]ship has to offer?"\n\nBut the mumbling ends as soon as [employer.GetTitledFirstName] enters the square, stopping [employer.GetHerHis] horse before me:"

379:  laamp_base_contract_schemes.6021.a: "Let's make it the #EMP easiest#! windfall."

439:  single_combat.0031.desc.opponent_response.desert_warrior.fatality:0 "deftly kicking my knees out from under me.

Tossed into the [sc_defender.Custom('GroundType')], I struggle to get up, totally out of breath.

[sc_victor.GetFirstNamePossessiveNoTooltip] [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')] [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponWoundVerb2ThirdPersonPresent')] into my chest from above, and, just like that, it's over. My limbs twitch pathetically, but the fight has left my body."
440:  single_combat.0031.desc.opponent_response.jungle_stalker.fatality:0 "whacking me square in the eye with the [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponEndType')] of [sc_victor.GetHerHis] [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')].

Surprised and already struggling against the foliage, my own [sc_loser.Custom('signature_weapon')] comes loose from my grasp.

Undefended, I'm easy prey for [sc_victor.GetFirstNameNoTooltip], and a series of [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponAttemptedHeavyPlural')] steadily eviscerate me."
441:  single_combat.0031.desc.opponent_response.open_terrain_expert.fatality:0 "It's not till I overextend that I see what [sc_victor.GetSheHe]'s doing. My [sc_loser.Custom('signature_weapon')] flung too far in front of me, [sc_victor.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] whirls [sc_victor.GetHerHis] [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')] back around, and white-hot pain explodes in my side.

I crumple, wheezing and coughing, gulping down strangulated gasps of air. It's all pointless.

[sc_victor.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponActionThirdPerson')] [sc_victor.GetHerHis] [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')] for the death-blow."
442:  single_combat.0031.desc.opponent_response.rough_terrain_expert.fatality.rocky:0 "I trip, slip, and fall down the slope, limbs akimbo.

Something sharp, rock or weapon, catches me in the spine, and my lower half goes numb while my upper half screams in agony. The world spins to a sudden halt. My arm is bending the wrong way, blood is filling up my eye, and I'm just so cold.

[sc_victor.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] looms above me, ready to end my misery."
443:  single_combat.0031.desc.opponent_response.rough_terrain_expert.fatality.boggy:0 "I slip and trip into a deep pool of brackish water.

My [sc_loser.Custom('signature_weapon')] is lost immediately, and as I flounder, a heavy boot comes down on the back of my neck, holding me beneath the foetid pool.

My every struggle is met with a casual swing of [sc_victor.GetFirstNamePossessiveNoTooltip] [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')], till I lack the strength to even try to force [sc_victor.GetHerHim] away from me."
444:  single_combat.0031.desc.opponent_response.forest_fighter.fatality:0 "the tree branch before I trip over it, tumbling into the undergrowth.

Thorns and brambles scrape my [sc_loser.Custom('MaskFace')], something tough tugs my [sc_loser.Custom('signature_weapon')] almost from my grasp. I fight to free it, bent double on the ground, when something cold as death [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponKillTypeRearTorsoThirdPersonActive')].

My collapse is immediate, dirt and rotting plants filling my mouth. I can't feel my legs and my arms have turned to mallow.

[sc_victor.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] kicks me onto my back for the killing blow."
445:  single_combat.0031.desc.opponent_response.raaargh.fatality:0 "[sc_loser.Custom('SignatureWeaponBreaksVerbPresentParticiple')] of my [sc_loser.Custom('signature_weapon')] with a single [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponAttemptedHeavy')].

[sc_victor.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] charges forwards, punching me so hard in the [sc_loser.Custom('MaskFace')] that I swallow several teeth and fly backwards, pivoting about my head.

I hit the [sc_defender.Custom('GroundType')] hard, totally unable to process what's happening. By the time I've returned to my senses, there's a boot descending viciously-fast on my [sc_loser.Custom('MaskFace')].

And again and again and again..."

701:  ## Defender Won, Opponent Finishing Move Injury
702:  single_combat.0041.desc.opponent_response.wait_and_hope.injury:0 "No parry meets me, no dodge evades me, and I have to pull myself back at the last instant to avoid [sc_victor.Custom2('SignatureWeaponKillTypeHeadThirdPersonPresentGendered',SCOPE.sC('sc_loser'))].

Instead, I simply rest my [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')] against it. Once more, [sc_loser.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] freezes, but it's clear I've won."
703:  single_combat.0041.desc.opponent_response.unsure_attack.injury:0 "Gambling on [sc_loser.GetFirstNamePossessiveNoTooltip] timidness, I lunge forward with a [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponAttemptedHeavy')] that knocks [sc_loser.GetHerHim] totally off-balance. Not stopping to breath, I boot [sc_loser.GetHerHim], hard, in the knee, and [sc_loser.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] falls with a heavy #EMP thud#!

 This gives me ample time to position myself for a gruesome kill. [sc_loser.GetSheHe|U] yields within seconds."
704:  single_combat.0041.desc.opponent_response.enthusiastic_onslaught.injury:0 "Picking my moment, I manage to get in a sharp crack across [sc_loser.GetHerHis] temple with my [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')]'s [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponEndType')], and [sc_loser.GetSheHe] goes down like a brained sheep.

I take a second or two to take in the pitiable sight of the [sc_loser.GetWomanMan] groaning in the [sc_defender.Custom('GroundType')] before me, then ready myself for the killing stroke.

[sc_loser.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] croaks out a yield with seconds left to spare."
705:  single_combat.0041.desc.opponent_response.hail_mary.injury:0 "desperation and ineptitude make awkward bedfellows. [sc_loser.GetHerHis|U] strikes mostly miss, and those that don't are easily parried or off of my [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')], causing [sc_loser.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] to rapidly lose [sc_loser.GetHerHis] footing.

When [sc_loser.GetSheHe] accidentally smacks [sc_loser.GetHerselfHimself] in the [sc_loser.Custom('MaskFace')] with [sc_loser.GetHerHis] own flailing hand, I take pity and knock the weapon from [sc_loser.GetHerHis] hand.

The yield comes quickly."
706:  single_combat.0041.desc.opponent_response.pocket_sand.injury:0 "[sc_loser.GetSheHe|U]'s too busy spluttering to notice or avoid my [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')]'s [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponEndType')] as I drive it into [sc_loser.GetHerHis] throat, and topples into the [sc_defender.Custom('GroundType')] immediately.

I leave my weapon resting gently on [sc_loser.GetFirstNamePossessiveNoTooltip] stomach, waiting patiently for [sc_loser.GetHerHim] to notice and yield. It doesn't take long."

887:  single_combat.0041.desc.sc_attacker.strict_guard.fatality:0 "The first strike smashes a gaping hole in [sc_loser.GetFirstNamePossessiveNoTooltip] guard, the second robs [sc_loser.GetHerHim] of the use of [sc_loser.GetHerHis] [sc_loser.Custom('signature_weapon')]-arm. My opponent stumbles, lucidity fading amidst an avalanche of pain.

I take my time lining up the next blow, [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponWoundVerb1PresentParticiple')] deep into the [sc_loser.GetWomanMan]'s chest with my [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')].

The next attack simply cuts the pain short."
888:  single_combat.0041.desc.sc_attacker.confident_attack.fatality:0 "When I judge the time to be right, I switch up my pattern with a surprise side-swipe that takes [sc_loser.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] right in the belly.

The strike hurls my foe backwards, something red and vital looking sliding limply out of the new hole as [sc_loser.GetSheHe] topples to the ground.

I approach with some caution, but it soon becomes clear that shock is setting in. Taking a moment to kick away [sc_loser.GetHerHis] [sc_loser.Custom('signature_weapon')] just in case, I prepare to put [sc_loser.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] out of [sc_loser.GetHerHis] misery."
889:  single_combat.0041.desc.sc_attacker.expert_onslaught.fatality:0 "Honestly, it's admirable that [sc_loser.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] is able to withstand as many [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')]-blows as [sc_loser.GetSheHe] does, as I rain down on [sc_loser.GetHerHim] with all the fury of a thunderous storm.

It takes a minute or two, but I eventually beat [sc_loser.GetHerHim] into a bloody, twisted, #EMP screaming#! heap.

Only when I'm satisfied there'll be no last-second chance for revenge do I administer the killing blow."
890:  single_combat.0041.desc.sc_attacker.attempt_disarm.fatality:0 "Giving no quarter, I throw myself into a [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponAttemptedHeavy')] that [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponWoundVerb4ThirdPersonPresent')] clean through [sc_loser.GetHerHis] rib cage.

I continue to attack [sc_loser.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] as [sc_loser.GetSheHe] staggers to the ground, sluggish and listless, stopping only when the only movements the corpse makes are from my blows."
891:  ### No need for a lightning_assault, as you can't end the duel in the first round.
892:  single_combat.0041.desc.sc_attacker.tire_opponent.fatality:0 "It's quite a while before a suitable gap opens in [sc_loser.GetFirstNamePossessiveNoTooltip] guard, but when it does, it's all I need. With a single [sc_victor.Custom('SignatureWeaponAttemptedHeavy')] from my [sc_victor.Custom('signature_weapon')], I tear through [sc_loser.GetHerHis] belly and into [sc_loser.GetHerHis] stomach.

Gore, bile, and my opponent's last meal flood out, showering my lower half, and [sc_loser.GetSheHe] lets out an ear-splitting scream.

It is, perhaps, a kindness when I end [sc_loser.GetFirstNamePossessiveNoTooltip] suffering early."

286:  coronation_events.1031.t: "The Choir Rises"
287:  coronation_events.1031.exalt.desc: "While the great hall echoes with the bustle of preparation, [priest.GetFirstName], my [ROOT.Char.Custom2('RelationToMe', SCOPE.sC('priest'))], approaches me with a collection of worn hymnals tucked under [priest.GetHerHis] arm.

"Your Majesty," [priest.GetSheHe] says with quiet pride, "the choir awaits your guidance. Shall their voices rise to proclaim your divine right and the splendor of the [ROOT.Char.GetPrimaryTitle.GetNameNoTooltip]?"

I picture the coming ceremony — every note lifting the realm higher in the eyes of the audience."
288:  coronation_events.1031.impress.desc: "As servants adjust decorations and squires rehearse their cues, [priest.GetFirstName], my [ROOT.Char.Custom2('RelationToMe', SCOPE.sC('priest'))], finds me amid the preparations.

"The realm will be listening closely," [priest.GetSheHe] says with a knowing smile. "Let the choir sing a hymn that moves hearts, and wins over your foolish naysayers."

It is a pleasing thought: the hall filled with sound, and every voice a part of my performance."
289:  coronation_events.1031.supporters.desc: "Among the tangle of scribes and cooks rushing through the corridors, [priest.GetFirstName], my [ROOT.Char.Custom2('RelationToMe', SCOPE.sC('priest'))], halts me with a gentle gesture.

"Your loyal supporters will be watching," [priest.GetSheHe] says. "Let the hymns remind them why they follow you: songs that bind willing hearts together, and deepens faith in your rule."

The choir waits for my choices, eager to begin rehearsals."
290:  coronation_events.1031.detractors.desc: "[priest.GetFirstName], my [ROOT.Char.Custom2('RelationToMe', SCOPE.sC('priest'))], approaches with lowered voice and a cautious glance around.

"Not all who gather will cheer your name," [priest.GetSheHe] warns. "When the hymns come, let them carry weight — authority the devils opposing you can't ignore. Fill those creatures' ears with the power of your crown!"

The choirmaster stands ready, awaiting my choice of tone and message."
291:  coronation_events.1031.a: ""Sing of my glory!""
292:  coronation_events.1031.b: ""Let the hymn call for peace and unity.""

At first I worry it might be a mirage, but as we get closer we can see some animals grazing around it.\n\nI find a small place in the shade, one where my guards and I can finally have a chance to rest our feet. A place to rest, for now. It is the perfect stopping point before we start looking for a way home."

169:  bp3_roaming.0090.desc: "It is getting late in the day, when we finally arrive at a small river, with no bridge in sight. I look as best I can, but there is nothing to be seen on the other side. In some ways, it feels like the border between the last vestiges of civilization, and the unknown wilderness on the other side.\n\nI take a moment to sit down, and rest my feet. Occasionally I feel like I can see something moving on the other side of the water, or like someone is watching me, but I cannot make anything out."
170:  bp3_roaming.0090.a: "A good stopping point, I think."

224:  laamp_base_learning_contract_events.4027.t: "$laamp_base_learning_contract_events_prefix.4021$: Conclusion"
225:  laamp_base_learning_contract_events.4027.desc.success.critical: "[employer.GetTitledFirstName] flips through the pages of the manuscript, stopping to contemplate a piece from each page. "I'll say..."

[employer.GetSheHe|U] turns and gently hands the manuscript to [employer.GetHerHis] attendant. "Have you seen this? I may just put this on #EMP display#!. Such a mind-boggling piece of scripture."

Softly applauding, [employer.GetSheHe] leans in, mischievously. "I particularly liked #EMP that#! piece of marginalia. Well done! Enjoy your rewards, and do let me know if ever you find yourself back in [employer.GetCapitalLocation.GetTitle.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip]."

I proudly stretch and nod."
226:  laamp_base_learning_contract_events.4027.desc.success.standard: "Curiously eyeing the manuscript, [employer.GetTitledFirstName] hums and nods. "Overall a job well done — I shall have it put up in my shelf with the rest of the works."

[employer.GetSheHe|U] hands over a respectably-sized satchel. "I trust this should compensate you for your time."

"Do let me know if you'd like to try again sometime," [employer.GetSheHe] finishes, as [employer.GetSheHe] turns to leave.

I accept the satchel and nod courteously."
227:  laamp_base_learning_contract_events.4027.desc.success.qualified: ""Not... quite what I had in mind. Certainly #EMP a piece of work#! but... " [employer.GetTitledFirstName] wrinkles [employer.GetHerHis] nose a bit as [employer.GetSheHe] hands off the manuscript to [employer.GetHerHis] attendant.

"...maybe I'll put it in one of the stacks. I trust you can see yourself out?" Not waiting for my answer, [employer.GetSheHe] has already left the room.

I pick up the meager satchel by the door and start wandering the halls in search for a way out."
228:  laamp_base_learning_contract_events.4027.desc.failure: ""What kind of..."" [employer.GetTitledFirstName] stops for a moment before tossing the manuscript to [employer.GetHerHis] attendant.

"You had the gall to spend my hard-come-by ink and sheets on this... #EMP drivel#!?"

Now wandering in small, frantic circles, [employer.GetSheHe] rubs [employer.GetHerHis] temples: "I invited you to my home. My #EMP study#!! And #EMP this#! is what you come up with? I have half a mind to call the guards on this betrayal!""

590:  ep3_contract_event.0082.desc: "A delegation of faithful [task_contract_employer.GetFaith.GetAdherentNamePluralNoTooltip] visit my camp, presenting a plea to rile the blood.\n\n"O, mighty [ROOT.Char.GetTitledFirstNameNoTooltip]!" they say. "We are just a collection of poor [task_contract_employer.GetFaith.DevoteeNeuterPlural]. "Day and night, we are harangued by missionaries sent from [task_contract_councillor_liege.GetCapitalLocation.GetName] by [task_contract_councillor_liege.GetTitledFirstName]! We've been forced to flee here — for in our home, the [task_contract_councillor.GetCouncilTitleFirstName] [task_contract_councillor.GetHerselfHimself] works evils! [task_contract_councillor.GetSheHe|U] converts those [task_contract_councillor.GetSheHe] nabs by force!"\n\nThe ragged refugees are on their knees in desperation.\n\n"In [task_contract_employer.GetTitledFirstNamePossessive] name — in [task_contract_employer.GetFaith.HighGodNamePossessive] — save us!""
591:  ep3_contract_event.0082.a: "I'll try halting [task_contract_councillor.GetCouncilTitleFirstNameNoTooltip]!"

586:  health.7000.t:0 "A Prisoner In My Own Body"
587:  health.7000.desc:0 "I knew that getting older would mean doing everything slower, but I didn't think it would all come to a halt until my death. Lately, I feel a constant malaise and everything takes more effort than before. I'm worried that if I lie down, I might not be able to get up again. There is no doubt that my time is running out."
588:  health.7000.desc_collapse:0 "I know I was pushing it – I should've just listened to what my body was telling me, but I chose to ignore it. "I'll finish this before going to bed; just a couple more, then I'll rest." Suddenly I felt light-headed, and as I got up, my vision went black.\n\nThe next day, I awoke in my bed, unable to get up as my body refuses to listen to me. Perhaps [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodName] decided to punish me for not treating this vessel meant to serve [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodNameAlternate] with respect."
589:  health.7000.desc_closing:0 "\n\nI feel like I can do naught but to await death's sweet embrace to claim me."
590:  health.7000.a:0 "How long will I have to wait?"

783:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.1071.desc.plains: "a mock cavalry charge across an even patch of ground, battering small sticks and branches at imaginary foes as they send an illusory foe skittering away in fear."
784:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.1071.desc.farmlands: "climbing a lone, gnarled tree standing crookedly in the middle of a farmer's field. The older children have made it much farther up, whilst the younger ones dally around the base."
785:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.1071.desc.hills: "rolling fiercely, end over end, down a grassy hill. There doesn't appear to be much skill involved, but the children are competing over who can go fastest all the same."
786:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.1071.desc.mountains: "hurling small rocks and stones off of a ridge, seeing how far out into the valleys below they can cast their little missiles. They whoop when one goes further than the rest, and giggle at those that skitter to a halt where they can still be seen."
787:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.1071.desc.desert: "hurling themselves down a tall dune, sending sprays of sand everywhere. Giggles and spits of #EMP ptth#!, #EMP ptth#! follow whenever a child gets some in their mouth. Which is often."
788:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.1071.desc.desert_mountains: "$ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.1071.desc.mountains$"
789:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.1071.desc.oasis: "building... little parcels of sand using leaves and grass? It's unclear what those would even be used f— another child creeps over a nearby dune, and suddenly a barrage of sand-bags go flying out like fire pots."

1056:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.2091.desc: "Around the campfire, a few followers share their evening meal.\n\nOddly, my [ROOT.Char.Custom2('RelationToMeShort', SCOPE.sC('attacker'))] [attacker.GetFirstName] and my [ROOT.Char.Custom2('RelationToMeShort', SCOPE.sC('defender'))] [defender.GetFirstName] sit among them — despite their mutual dislike.\n\n[defender.GetFirstNameNoTooltip|U] mutters something under [defender.GetHerHis] breath. Whatever it is, it sends [attacker.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] into a blind rage. Steel flashes. Blood is about to spill."

1300:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.4041.desc.weather_type.wild_fires.treeline: "With so much foliage to burn through, the wild fire is catching up in leaps and bounds — the occasional detonation of particularly dry, sap-heavy trees a grim, startling reminder of the grisly fate that awaits anything and anyone too slow to get away.

Oily tendrils of perversely fragrant smoke chase us ahead of the blaze, choking the weak and leaving"
1301:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.4041.desc.weather_type.wild_fires.fallback: "The wild fire's moving faster than we are, finding #EMP just#! enough fuel to burn rapaciously towards our convoy. Anyone and anything too slow to get away will be burnt alive — laden mule and lingering child alike.

Worse yet, vast gouts of smoke billow out ahead of the blaze, occasionally washing over us to choke the life from the vulnerable, leaving"
1302:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.4041.desc.weather_type.avalanche: "It's a surprisingly soft sound that heralds imminent danger: a vast, gentle #EMP whumph#! from far above.

Dozens of eyes amidst the convoy rise to the peaks towering over us, before the peal of a thunderbolt greater than that wielded by any storm rings out across the range.

"#BER AVALANCHE!#!" screams someone. Suddenly, all is chaos, men and animals alike breaking rapidly for even the slightest shelter from the cascade of white death now rushing towards us, leaving"
1303:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.4041.desc.weather_type.flood: "The fog seems to set in from almost nowhere — one moment the air is humid, then it's thickened to near-soup.

From above, a few droplets of rain fall, and a nearby stream starts to rapidly swell its banks. Tension strikes the convoy, causing the men and carts alike to trundle to a gradual halt. No one can quite say what the issue is, but #EMP something#! is wrong.

Within a minute, the once-steady ground beneath has turned to thick mud, and water everywhere begins to swell from below. "Flood, #EMP flash flood#!!" goes the cry from someone, leaving"
1304:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.4041.desc.weather_type.frozen_water: "The snow here is persistent but not harsh enough to pose a problem, just enough to blanket the world in a thick carpet of white. Our convoy passes through a clear spot in the forest, relishing the break from the tree cover, a little chance to appreciate the wonderland around.

#BER Crack.#!

Dozens of eyes are cast downwards, seeing with mounting horror a vast split opening in the grou- no, the surface of the #EMP frozen lake#!! There's no time to lose, no time to think, as one we flee — even with"
1305:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.4041.desc.weather_type.earthquake: "The world shifts beneath our feet. Men and mules stagger, babies raise a unified wail, and several cart wheels snap as they are lifted up then slammed back down or shunted sideways.

A half second of panic settles in convoy-wide after the jolt: what was that? Will there be more, or was that i-

#EMP The earth itself begins to shake#!. In the middle distance, a fissure opens and begins snaking, faster than a man can run, directly for us. The sight immediately leaves"
1306:  ep3_laamp_flavour_ewan.4041.desc.outro: "my followers on the edge of breaking."

31:  travel_events_oltner_2.1030.desc: "Journeying across the sands of [location.GetName], a caravan of laden camels crosses our path. The caravan master notices our entourage and halts the procession.\n\n"Noble travelers," [local_character.GetSheHe] calls out with a shrewd glint in [local_character.GetHerHis] eye, "perhaps you'd fancy a glance at the treasures these sturdy beasts carry? For the right price, the wonders of the desert could accompany you on your travels.""
32:  travel_events_oltner_2.1030.a: ""I am keen to see your wares, let us barter.""
33:  travel_events_oltner_2.1030.b: ""No need, but perhaps we can travel together for a while?""
34:  travel_events_oltner_2.1030.c: ""Show me something unique, a true treasure of [location.GetNameNoTooltip].""

146:  travel_events_oltner_2.1140.t: "Diminutive Defenders"
147:  travel_events_oltner_2.1140.desc: "At the foot of a particularly imposing hill fort in [location.GetName], a group of children play at warriors, their laughter a counterpoint to the solemnity of the stone.\n\nOne child, bold and bright-eyed, approaches with a wooden sword. "Halt! No one may pass the fort of [local_character.GetFirstName] and [local_character.GetHerHis] [local_character.Custom('ComplimentAdjective')] band!" the child exclaims gleefully. "Oh wait, a... are you a [ROOT.Char.GetTitleAsNameNoTooltip]!?""
148:  travel_events_oltner_2.1140.a: ""That's right! Now go tell your village all about me!""
149:  travel_events_oltner_2.1140.b: ""Brave defenders, tell us the quickest way through these [location.Custom('TerrainTypeProvince')].""
150:  travel_events_oltner_2.1140.c: ""#EMP *Draw your weapon and scare the children off*#!""

22:  building_confucius_temple_destination_desc: "It is hard to not feel a great reverence at the [GetBuilding('confucius_temple_01').GetName]. This is the oldest sanctuary of the great teacher and role model that has so shaped the world. Soon I find myself quietly line up with the other pilgrims to see the tombs of him and his disciples."
23:  building_citadel_linan_destination_desc: "On the slopes of Phoenix hill the [GetBuilding('citadel_linan_01').GetName] is the center of administrative power for not just this city but also the surrounding region. Entering through its gates I am surrounded by dignitaries and scholar officials, all fulfilling the ceremonial roles that their positions entail."
24:  building_sanchi_stupa_destination_desc: "The dome of the [GetBuilding('sanchi_stupa_01').GetName] is the main focal point on a hill outside of the settlement of Sanchi itself. Among the many pilgrims and monks I run into at this location many claim that the temple complex has been in use for thousands of years."
25:  building_boudhanath_destination_desc: "The enormous dome of the [GetBuilding('boudhanath_01').GetName] Stupa houses remains and relics related to many historical buddhas, it is also by far the tallest building of Kathmandu. Towering over the rest of the city it is a clear indicator of the importance of Buddhism to the history of this city. As I approach I find myself surrounded by travellers, pilgrims and merchants, all stopping to rest and pray."
26:  building_mont_st_michel_destination_desc: "Approaching the tidal island of [GetBuilding('mont_st_michel_01').GetName] at ebb sees its magnificent church and walls towering on the horizon, a reminder of God's power above Heaven and Earth. The site is both an important religious center and a fortified stronghold for the local monks and fishermen."
27:  building_holy_site_st_peters_basilica_destination_desc: "Towering over Vatican hill, on the site of Saint Peters tomb, [GetBuilding('holy_site_st_peters_basilica_01').GetName] is a reminder of the power of the western church and its popes. Priests and nuns can be seen all over this part of the eternal city, along with beggars hoping for donations from the many pilgrims."
28:  building_holy_site_imam_ali_mosque_destination_desc: "Entering the city, the golden dome of the [GetBuilding('holy_site_imam_ali_mosque_01').GetName] shines like a beacon. This holy site, where Imam [ali.GetFirstName] is laid to rest, is filled with pilgrims paying their respects. The air is thick with devotion, and the intricate calligraphy on the walls speaks of a deep reverence for the divine."

697:  hunt.4900.desc:1 "The great beast halts just before reaching us, [activity.Custom('GetAnimalSoundParticipleKill')] and [activity.Custom('GetAnimalStrikeParticipleKill')] wildly."
698:  hunt.4900.hunter:1 "\n\nI draw my knife from my belt and put myself between the [activity.Custom('GetAnimalTypeKill')] and [similar_participant.GetFirstName] just before the animal suddenly [activity.Custom('GetAnimalChargePresentKill')] forward.\n\nMy blade finds its heart,"
699:  hunt.4900.hunter_wound:1 "but not before I am knocked aside, narrowly avoiding its [activity.Custom('GetAnimalDangerKill')]..."
700:  hunt.4900.hunter_dead:1 "but, looking down, its [activity.Custom('GetAnimalDangerKill')] have found mine.\n\nThe light dims as I lie in a tangle of fur, warm flesh, and blood, with [similar_participant.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] calling my name..."

703:  hunt.4900.assist_wound:0 "but [similar_participant.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] is clearly wounded..."
704:  hunt.4900.assist_dead:0 "but so does [similar_participant.GetFirstNameNoTooltip]..."
705:  hunt.4900.assist_kill:0 "and [similar_participant.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] stands over it smugly wiping [similar_participant.GetHerHis] blade..."
706:  hunt.4900.befriend:2 "

I calmly hold out my hand. The [activity.Custom('GetAnimalTypeKill')] relaxes, confused, before tentatively halting just out of reach, sniffing at my digits suspiciously."
707:  hunt.4900.befriend_success:1 "

Seemingly content, it yawns widely, before laying at my feet, as if to sleep."
708:  hunt.4900.befriend_wound:1 "

709:  hunt.4900.befriend_dead:1 "

264:  pilgrimage.1110.desc:0 "Crossing the [ROOT.Char.GetCurrentLocation.Custom('GetTerrainTypePlural')] of [heathen_raider_county.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip], we spot the banners of a small host, emblazoned with the [heathen_raider.GetFaith.GetAdjective] [heathen_raider.GetFaith.ReligiousSymbol]. They are ragged vagabonds, preying on pilgrims headed to [ROOT.Char.GetInvolvedActivity.GetCurrentPhase.GetLocation.GetName].\n\nThe leader swiftly blocks our route, rearing [ROOT.Char.GetHerHis] horse and announcing [heathen_raider.GetHerselfHimself] as [heathen_raider.GetFirstName]."
265:  pilgrimage.1110.shared_target_heathen_hajj:0 ""Halt [ROOT.Char.Custom2('GetUnbelieverTerm', heathen_raider)]! By [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodName], the [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.GetAdherentNamePlural] must pay the Kaaba toll.""
266:  pilgrimage.1110.shared_target_controlled_hajj:0 ""A small payment to see the Kaaba is all I ask from its [heathen_raider.Custom2('GetUnbelieverTermAdjective', ROOT.Char)] [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.GetAdjective] stewards.""
267:  pilgrimage.1110.shared_target_heathen_jerusalem:0 ""Fear not [heathen_raider.Custom2('GetUnbelieverTermPlural', ROOT.Char)], the marvels of our holy city await, for a small fee.""
268:  pilgrimage.1110.shared_target_controlled_jerusalem:0 ""If you truly wish to see your coveted holy city, my small fee is little umbrage.""

269:  pilgrimage.1110.shared_target_heathen:0 ""Don't you [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.GetAdjective] dogs know? [ROOT.Char.Custom2('GetUnbelieverTermPlural', heathen_raider)|U] must offer tribute to see the sacred [heathen_raider.GetFaith.HouseOfWorshipPlural].""

357:  pilgrimage.2006.intro:1 "The spiritual journey has grind to a literal halt."
358:  pilgrimage.2006.desc_alone:0 "I keep my eyes peeled, trying to recognize the way forward — but coming up with bupkis — and am becoming slightly concerned. It #EMP was#!\n\nthis direction, wasn't it... ? I hesitantly look over yonder to a local peasant involved in chores a bit further ahead."
359:  pilgrimage.2006.desc_travel_leader:1 "My $travel_leader_court_position$ [caravan_master.GetTitledFirstName] is looking around, frantically searching for the way forward, and people are starting to notice.\n\n[caravan_master.GetTitledFirstNamePossessiveNoTooltip] face shifts to a gray nuance as [caravan_master.GetSheHe] turns [caravan_master.GetHerHis] gaze towards me, looking for answers as to what to do next."
360:  pilgrimage.2006.a:1 "I know the way to [ROOT.Char.GetTravelPlan.GetData.GetNextDestination.GetProvince.GetNameNoTooltip] like the back of my hand!"

499:  pilgrimage.6005.b:0 ""We should pay for our misfortunes!""
500:  pilgrimage.6005.c:0 ""Is it a crime to have a good time?""
501:  #You find out your friend is a Non-Believer
502:  pilgrimage.6006.desc:0 "[friend.GetFirstName] and I are nearing the end of today's journey. We are slowly making our way toward the determined stopping point, when suddenly someone ahead shouts, "Look! What a #EMP marvelous#! sunset!"\n\nEveryone surges ahead with the last bit of their strength to get a glimpse of the majestic site. "What wonders we are privileged to see in this mortal life! This is a perfect time to meditate on our faith," I say to [friend.GetFirstNameNoTooltip], but [friend.GetSheHe] seems not at all impressed, letting a harsh scoff escape [friend.GetHerHis] lips.\n\n"It is but a sunset!" [friend.GetSheHe] yells. "Must everything we do on this trip concern [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodName]? I just want to travel and see the world — I'm not even convinced [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodName] exists #EMP at all!#!""
503:  pilgrimage.6006.a:0 ""Your secret is safe with me, friend.""
504:  pilgrimage.6006.b:0 ""I shall not abide a friend who does not believe.""
505:  pilgrimage.6006.c:0 ""You make some good points...""

836:  pilgrimage.6531.t:0 "Hidden Divinity"
837:  pilgrimage.6531.desc_wellspring:0 "Quite a distance outside of [ROOT.Char.GetCurrentLocation.GetCounty.GetTitle.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip], we come to a sudden halt. Our guide [local_guide.GetTitledFirstName] shows us a hidden passage and we end up in a small cavern, illuminated by the daylight falling through a hole in the roof.

Through that very same hole, a truly remarkable wellspring pours, serenely. The flowing water glows with a divine splendor and faint misty rainbows color the air around it."
838:  pilgrimage.6531.desc_crystal_cavern:0 "As I start to wonder if we'll ever arrive, our guide [local_guide.GetTitledFirstName] suddenly takes a sharp left and before we know it we enter a cavern, hidden in the countryside.

A faint glow, that steadily grows stronger, starts reflecting over our gear as we stumble into a large grotto covered in hundreds of crystals. The crystals catch the light from the hole in the ceiling and the entourage, including myself, fawns in astonishment at the sight."
839:  pilgrimage.6531.desc_non_cynical:0 "

I have never felt [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodNamePossessive] presence stronger than in this very spot."
840:  pilgrimage.6531.desc_cynical:0 "

This is a very impressive feat of nature, I'll give it that."

Truly the [pretty_peasant_county_scope.GetProvince.Custom('TerrainTypeProvince')] of [ROOT.Char.GetCurrentLocation.GetNameNoTooltip] must be the fairest in all of [ROOT.Char.GetPrimaryTitle.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip], and fairer still are the [pretty_peasant.GetWomenMen] who call it home.\n\nAs my entourage escorts me through yet another lowly village, I find a particularly fair young [pretty_peasant.GetWomanMan] going about [pretty_peasant.GetHerHis] lowly duties and I feel my heart grow aflutter. Watching this [pretty_peasant.Custom('LoverPetName')] in [pretty_peasant.GetHerHis] mundanity is like seeing poetry made flesh, and before I can even think, my heart has already commanded me to call my entourage to a halt."

483:  tour_grounds_events.3010.desc.intro:0 "My ride through the grounds of [touring_grounds_scope.GetNameNoTooltip] is brought to a sudden jolting halt as I feel my prized horse stumble over a rock. Though it is quick to recover, and I am only momentarily thrown off balance, I can hear members of my procession snickering behind me.\n\n"
484:  tour_grounds_events.3010.desc.mid.irritable:0 "I have been failed by my allegedly prized steed, and I feel a stew of humiliation and rage bubbling in my guts."
485:  tour_grounds_events.3010.desc.mid.calm:0 "I feel a little embarrassed, but I know really it isn't the animal's fault."
486:  tour_grounds_events.3010.desc.outro:0 "A [ROOT.Char.GetTitleAsNameNoTooltip|U] is meant to give off an air of untouchable regality, and command the respect of all of [ROOT.Char.GetHerHis] subjects, and this incident has thrown off my image of perfection."

585:  tour_grounds_events.3060.d:0 "Perhaps I could learn something here."
586:  tour_grounds_events.3070.title:0 "A Moment of Silence"
587:  tour_grounds_events.3070.desc.intro:0 "I find myself wandering with my entourage around the wonderful sights outside of [ROOT.Char.GetCurrentLocation.GetName] proper, and"
588:  tour_grounds_events.3070.desc.royal_garden:0 "around [stop_host_scope.GetNamePossessive] magnificent royal garden.

Within the walls of the garden, there is nothing but myself, a few lesser nobles, and a precise and intricately arranged garden. Stopping for a moment to be here fills me with a tranquility I rarely get the chance to experience."
589:  tour_grounds_events.3070.desc.royal_forest:0 "around [stop_host_scope.GetNamePossessive] enchanting royal forest.

This forest is completely void of any peasants or lesser nobility; just me, my closest confidants, and [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.CreatorNamePossessive|U] creation. I feel transported to a realm of pure calm, a time before the calamitous hearts of men tainted the earth with vice and weakness."
590:  tour_grounds_events.3070.desc.leisure_palace:0 "around [stop_host_scope.GetNamePossessive] summer palace.

The palace exterior is decorated with gorgeous sculptures and local flora arranged to meticulous detail, and the interior is just as grand and extravagant. Everything about the sights and sensations of being in this palace exist to calm a strained soul."
591:  tour_grounds_events.3070.desc.outro:0 "

I could stay here forever."

12:  childhood.7001.desc_helper:0 "Success! [child_helper.GetFirstName] distracted [stolen_clothes.GetFirstName] by letting [ROOT.Char.Custom('GetLivestockFowlIndef')] loose in [stolen_clothes.GetHerHis] bedchamber early this morning – meanwhilst I pilfered every garment I could find!"
13:  childhood.7001.desc_nohelper:0 "Success! I managed to sneak into [stolen_clothes.GetFirstNamePossessiveNoTooltip] bedchamber and grab all of [stolen_clothes.GetHerHis] clothes before [stolen_clothes.GetSheHe] woke up! "
14:  childhood.7001.desc_angry:0 "[stolen_clothes.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] rose in a fury and gave chase down the corridor, without a thread on [stolen_clothes.GetHerHis] body!

"You annoying brat! Hand me my clothes immediately, or I'll wring your neck!" [stolen_clothes.GetSheHe|U] screams, fuming through the nose.

[stolen_clothes.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] might not have liked my clever prank, but everyone else thought it was #EMP hilarious!#!"
15:  childhood.7001.desc_funny:0 "[stolen_clothes.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] rose quickly and gave chase down the corridor, without a thread on [stolen_clothes.GetHerHis] body!

"Child! Give me my clothes back, I do not have time for this!" [stolen_clothes.GetSheHe|U] shouts, running all the way into the main hall before stopping and realizing what [stolen_clothes.GetSheHe] has done!

Everyone, including [stolen_clothes.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] found the situation #EMP very#! funny, and laughed until their faces turned red."
16:  childhood.7001.a:0 "And I'll do it again! And again! And #EMP again!#!"
17:  childhood.7001.b:0 "I couldn't have done it without you, [child_helper.GetFirstNameNoTooltip]!"
18:  childhood.7001.c:0 "A good prank goes a long way!"

80:  court.3030.desc.intro:0 "Ever so attentive, my $lady_in_waiting_court_position$, [fussy_liw.GetFirstName], is at my heels to ensure I both conduct and present myself appropriately at court.\n\n"[ROOT.Char.Custom('FormOfAddressForLiege')|U]! Please, stand still for but a moment so that I may adjust your clothes!"\n\n"
81:  court.3030.desc.lovers:1 "I instinctively lean into [fussy_liw.GetHerHis] touch before stopping myself as I realize we're in public. While it's not uncommon for my dearest [fussy_liw.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] to be so fussy with my garb,"
82:  court.3030.desc.generic:1 "[fussy_liw.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] doesn't seem to mind that we're in public while [fussy_liw.GetSheHe] adjusts my garb,"
83:  court.3030.desc.ending:0 "I cannot help but feel as if [fussy_liw.GetSheHe]'s treating me like a rowdy child!\n\nAs I'm silently ruminating, I notice we have onlookers whispering among themselves and I feel the need to speak up for myself!"
84:  court.3030.a:0 "Make a scene: "How #EMP dare you#! lay your hands on #EMP me#!!?""

207:  court.4701.trepanning_incapable_injury:0 "A glow flows over me. I feel a rush, and I see sights of the days and years of the past all appear at once. Where am I? Why do I have a headache? What is my name? What is my favorite pie filling?"
208:  court.4701.trepanning_possessed_injury:0 "Though I was promised I was releasing spirits from my head, I suddenly witness a spirit for the first time. A handsome winged shade is dancing from shadow to shadow in the room and grinning at me."
209:  court.4701.trepanning_deviant_injury:0 "As the hole begins to be dug, I start to relish the sound of my squelching innards. After some spinning of my mind, I am hit with sudden rushes of genius! I must become nocturnal and consume only bread crusts! Why have I never made love while pretending to be a horse?"
210:  court.4701.trepanning_learning_penalty:0 "As the scalpel swirls around and around, I realize I am struggling to so much as cry #EMP halt! #!When the motion at last ceases, my poor swimming mind feels it must wade through mud to form a sentence.""
211:  court.4701.trepanning_physical_injury:0 "At first the picks clipping my skull send such pain through my body my very spine feels sawn in two. As the excavation goes deeper,"
212:  court.4701.trepanning_no_result:0 "I get ahold of myself. When the pick is at last removed, and I feel no different beyond a mild draft blowing onto my exposed brain."
213:  court.4701.trepanning_coordination_penalty:0 "I start to feel nothing at all. When the pick is at last removed, I cannot feel it. As I attempt to stand, my body barely complies."

300:  court.8160.t:0 "Foremost [ROOT.Char.Custom('MountedWarriorTerm')|U]"
301:  court.8160.desc.intro:0 "A healthy rivalry between mettlesome fighters is to be expected, but the growing discord between [knight_1.GetFirstName] and [knight_2.GetFirstName] is souring the mood at court. 

[knight_1.GetTitledFirstNameNoTooltip] is widely regarded to be more skilled, but [knight_2.GetTitledFirstNameNoTooltip] clearly takes issue with the assertion. 

In the middle of an audience, the latter bursts into my throne room, and, clutching [knight_2.GetHerHis] sword-hilt, cries "[knight_1.GetFirstNameNoTooltip]! Only one of us can claim to be the [ROOT.Char.GetTitleAsNamePossessiveNoTooltip] most skilled [ROOT.Char.Custom('MountedWarriorTerm')], meet me outside and I will settle the question!"

[knight_1.GetTitledFirstNameNoTooltip] replies [knight_2.Custom('quirk_neg_adverb')], "I would cut you to pieces where you stand if it was not for the presence of my [ROOT.Char.GetTitleAsNameNoTooltip], you [knight_2.Custom('quirk_neg_adjective')] [knight_2.Custom2('InsultNoun', SCOPE.sC('knight_1'))]! Apologize and I may spare your life!" 

I better act quickly if this escalation is to be halted..."
302:  court.8160.a:0 "You shall both serve me directly."
303:  court.8160.a.tt: "[knight_1.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] and [knight_2.GetFirstNamePossessiveNoTooltip] rivalry ensures that, as long as they are both employed, they will give their very best in their positions: [aptitude|E] Increased."

79:  hold_court.8040.desc:0 "The unrepentant [infidel_vassal.GetTitledFirstName] graces you with [infidel_vassal.GetHerHis] presence. \n\nHaltingly, [infidel_vassal.GetSheHe] begins: "My [ROOT.Char.GetTitleTierName], I am a loyal and willing subject – let me practice my faith in peace." \n\n"
80:  hold_court.8040.desc.intro_same_religion:0 ""We [infidel_vassal.GetFaith.GetAdherentNamePlural] worship [infidel_vassal.GetFaith.CreatorName] just as the [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.GetAdherentNamePlural] do. Leave your [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetAdjective] [ROOT.Char.Custom('SisterBrother')]s to worship as they please, united instead against the wicked [ROOT.Char.Custom('GetUnbelieverNamePlural')] who follow false demons and allow [infidel_vassal.GetFaith.DevilName] to corrupt their hearts.""
81:  hold_court.8040.desc.intro_fallback:0 ""Why can't a [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetAdjective] and a [infidel_vassal.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetAdjective] live in harmony, separated by the teachings of [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodName] and [infidel_vassal.GetFaith.HighGodName] but united in piety? Let us follow our [infidel_vassal.GetFaith.ReligiousText] and you your [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.ReligiousText] side by side."
82:  hold_court.8040.a:0 "Judgment is reserved for [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodName] alone."

189:  study_scripture_outcome.1030.desc: "My studies have halted. The same desk, same candle, same defeats. So I seek out my [ROOT.Char.Custom2( 'RelationToMeShort', counselor )], [counselor.GetTitledFirstName], whose devotion asks nothing of rank.\n\n"
190:  study_scripture_outcome.1030.desc_hermitage: ""You bring too many walls with you," [counselor.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] says, with a gesture to the bare cell, the lamp, the silence. "The hermits of old knew: strip everything away, and what is left is what you sought.""
191:  study_scripture_outcome.1030.desc_monastery: ""You study like a ruler," [counselor.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] says, not unkindly. "Conquering pages, counting them like taxes. In this house we sit with one line for a week, and by the end it is the line that studies us.""
192:  study_scripture_outcome.1030.a: "Arrange a blessing for my study."

47:  travel_events.2002.t:0 "The Trodden Path"
48:  travel_events.2002.desc:0 "The procession has ground to a halt a stone's throw away from [ROOT.Char.GetCurrentLocation.GetName]. I look over to see my [ROOT.Char.Custom2('RelationToMe', SCOPE.sC('guide_leader'))] [guide_leader.GetFirstName], dismounted and intently staring at something on the ground. The other entourage members have gathered around [guide_leader.GetHerHim].\n\n[guide_leader.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] looks up as I approach. "[ROOT.Char.Custom('FormOfAddressForLiege')|U], there is an ant path here. I may be a tad superstitious, but you should never cross an ant path."\n\n[guide_leader.GetSheHe|U] pauses. "My great-grand[great_grand_parent.Custom('MotherFather')] did, and [great_grand_parent.GetSheHe] never returned home.""
49:  travel_events.2002.a:0 "#EMP Fine#!. We'll find another path."
50:  travel_events.2002.b:1 "This is nonsense. I'll take over as guide!"
51:  travel_events.2002.c:0 "I have just the cure for your superstition."

135:  travel_events.2008.desc:0 "Beads of sweat keep pour down my face as the heat of the jungle catches up with me. Stopping to wipe my brow, I spot my [elephant_rival.Custom2('InsultNoun', ROOT.Char)] [ROOT.Char.Custom2('RelationToMeShort', SCOPE.sC('elephant_rival'))], [elephant_rival.GetTitledFirstName], over by the local elephant pens of [ROOT.Char.GetCurrentLocation.GetName].\n\n[elephant_rival.GetSheHe|U] makes a rude gesture in my direction and lets out a boisterous laugh, no doubt mocking me. I clench my jaw.\n\nThat's when I notice [elephant_rival.GetTitledFirstNameNoTooltip] is standing #EMP right behind the elephant#!, and the beast is on the move. I manage to catch the attention of its mahout."

463:  epidemic_events.5900.t: "The Black Death"
464:  epidemic_events.5900.desc: "Pestilence stalks the land.

Grisly, bubbling buboes grow upon the victims, whose pitiful calls for help are slowly stifled as they gutter and drown in their own pus-filled throats.

From the lowliest urchin to the most fêted emperor, all dread the indiscriminate scythe of the merciless plague. Those that survive must watch helplessly as all around them perish.

The devoted look to the divine for a savior, and the powerful their riches, but none can truly be safe. Dreadful tendrils spread across the land, constricting it until it no longer breathes.

The Black Death is upon us. [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodName] save us all."
465:  epidemic_events.5900.desc_asia: "Pestilence walks among us.

The afflicted bloat with sores, their cries fading to gurgles as breath fails. In death, even the loudest are made quiet.

No one is spared. From the barefoot laborer to the cloistered prince, the wheel of suffering turns for all. The living are left to sweep ash from thresholds and count the empty mats.

Some chant sutras, others cling to ritual and rank — but no decree halts decay, no merit offsets the toll. Like mist in a valley, the plague spreads unseen, yet felt in every still morning.

The Black Death is here. Heaven avert its gaze."
466:  epidemic_events.5900.christian: ""Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name...""
467:  epidemic_events.5900.fallback: "May we persevere in these grim times."

247:  pam_tenet_events.0006.desc_intro: "The unmarked books are spread on my table, their diagrams laid bare, their names unfit for any mouth to shape. This is the learning the plainly devout are warned against, and I have bought myself a night with it."
248:  pam_tenet_events.0006.desc_witness: "\n\n[mystic_witness.GetTitledFirstName] halts on the threshold and will not cross. "These things are locked away and prayed over for a reason," [mystic_witness.GetSheHe] murmurs. "Once you have looked, you cannot unknow what is there.""

250:  pam_tenet_events.0006.a: "Nothing in these pages is above me. Read on."
251:  pam_tenet_events.0006.b: "Go as far as the lamp burns, and no further."

48:  tgp_china_career.0030.desc: "My elder, [deceased_elder.GetFirstName], has passed from this world: I am told [deceased_elder.GetSheHe] [deceased_elder.GetDeathReason]. 331:  tgp_japan_yearly_events.1200.desc: "It's been a long morning of meetings in [kampaku.GetCurrentLocation.GetBaronyNameExplicitly], the work of a [kampaku.GetTitleAsName] is never done! 119:  natural_disaster.7021.desc: "Wind pushes foreign waters into the nearby [river_region.GetNameNoTooltip], pushing the bank far beyond its limits. Some collect the excess water for their own needs, but the water continues to overflow.\n\nThe surrounding countryside becomes a marsh, and mud collects on the buildings around town."
120:  natural_disaster.7021.a: "These waters are unbound."
121:  natural_disaster.7031.t: "[river_region.GetNameNoTooltip]: Torrential Downpours"
122:  natural_disaster.7031.desc: "A much needed precipitation falls upon the lands nearing the [river_region.GetNameNoTooltip], ensuring the harvest will continue as cultivated.\n\nThough the earth is more than sated, the rain grows in intensity and shows no sign of stopping. The sun is nowhere to be seen, and the river begins to overflow inland."
123:  natural_disaster.7031.a: "May the skies show mercy."

341:  tournament_events.1330.t:0 "The Next Generation"
342:  tournament_events.1330.desc:0 ""Good luck, [ROOT.Char.Custom('FormOfAddressForLiege')]!" I acknowledge the shout from a member of the gathering crowd with a grateful wave. "And good luck to you too, [heir.GetFirstName]!"\n\n"What did they mean by that?" I ask [heir.GetFirstNameNoTooltip], striding along beside me. "Why would they need to wish you luck?" [heir.GetHerHis|U] nervous look quickly gave the answer to that question.\n\n"I... I want to compete!" [heir.GetSheHe|U] insists. "You're participating, why can't I?" I stop dead, [heir.GetFirstNameNoTooltip] stumbling to halt alongside me uncertainly, [heir.GetHerHis] bravado crumbling somewhat in the face of my reaction."
343:  tournament_events.1330.a:0 "You need to understand. You are far too precious to risk."
344:  tournament_events.1330.b:0 "What a privilege it is to have such a [heir.Custom('GetDaughterSon')]!"
345:  tournament_events.1330.c:0 "I forbid this! Go and resign right now!"
